modules.title: Getting Started
modules.description: Set up your organisation, bring people in, and make Praesto yours: your profile, status, theme and passwordless sign-in.

videos.title: Setting Up Your Organisation
videos.description: Create your company’s workspace in a few minutes: name it, choose your working days, start a 14-day free trial and add the contact details employees will see.

videos.title: Joining Your Company’s Workspace
videos.description: When your company already uses Praesto: sign in with your work account, ask to join, and get in as soon as an admin approves.

videos.title: Approving People Who Ask to Join
videos.description: Admins see everyone who has asked to join the organisation, check who they are, and approve or decline each request.

videos.title: Your Profile, Status and Theme
videos.description: Your own record in one place, a status so colleagues know if you’re free, the devices that get notifications, and light or dark mode.

videos.title: Passwordless Sign-In with Passkeys
videos.description: Sign in with Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello or a security key instead of a password, and manage the devices you’ve added.

modules.title: Platform Overview
modules.description: The screens everyone uses every day: Today, the company calendar, team chat and the organisation chart.

videos.title: Your Day at a Glance
videos.description: The Today screen: your hours, the month’s attendance, every request waiting on you and what’s happening across the organisation, arranged the way you like.

videos.title: One Calendar for the Whole Company
videos.description: Company events and holidays on one shared calendar, today’s schedule beside it, and new events in a couple of clicks.

videos.title: Team Chat
videos.description: Direct conversations with colleagues inside Praesto, with files, pinned messages and real-time delivery, so work talk stays at work.

videos.title: Your Organisation, Mapped
videos.description: Headcount at a glance, every team with its lead and members, the people not yet on a team, and search across all of it.

modules.title: Employees
modules.description: One directory for everyone, with employment status, KYC, company assets and a clear process when someone leaves.

videos.title: Employee Directory and Profiles
videos.description: Every employee in one searchable directory, and a full profile for each: work details, contact, statutory numbers and the assets they hold.

videos.title: Employment Status
videos.description: Keep each person’s status accurate: active, terminated or absconded, with the reason and date recorded, and PF, UAN and ESIC numbers alongside.

videos.title: Employee KYC
videos.description: Employees complete their own KYC in five guided steps; HR sees every status at a glance and reviews, approves or asks for changes.

videos.title: Company Assets
videos.description: Track laptops, phones and monitors: who has what, what’s free or in repair, returns, and issues reported by employees.

videos.title: Resignations and Exit
videos.description: Employees resign inside Praesto, managers and HR approve, and your exit policy sets notice periods, checklists and exit interviews.

modules.title: Attendance
modules.description: Every workday accounted for: punches and hours, corrections, Geofencing around the office, work from home and holidays.

videos.title: Attendance at a Glance
videos.description: An employee’s whole month: present days, leave, corrections left, a colour-coded calendar and a daily record of punches and hours.

videos.title: Correcting Attendance
videos.description: HR fixes a missed or wrong punch for an employee, with the change previewed and counted against the monthly correction allowance.

videos.title: Attendance Rules and Geofencing
videos.description: Set the working day, grace period and correction window, then turn on Geofencing and place the office on a map so punches only count nearby.

videos.title: Work From Home
videos.description: Employees request work-from-home days, managers approve in one click, and approved days count correctly in attendance.

videos.title: Holidays
videos.description: The year’s holidays by month, how many are left and when the next one is, shown on everyone’s calendar and counted in attendance.

modules.title: Leave
modules.description: Apply in seconds, approve in one click, and set the leave policy your organisation runs on.

videos.title: Applying for Leave
videos.description: Choose full days, a half day or a few hours, pick the dates and type, and send it to your approver with the balance and duration shown first.

videos.title: Manager Approval
videos.description: Managers see their team’s leave requests, filter by status, check dates and reasons, and approve or reject, one at a time or in bulk.

videos.title: Leave Policy
videos.description: Set yearly paid, sick and casual leave, require a medical certificate for sick leave, and add your own leave types with accrual, carry forward and encashment.

modules.title: Payroll
modules.description: Take each month from draft to approved to disbursed, set up salary structures, and give employees their payslips.

videos.title: Payroll Runs
videos.description: Each month’s payroll moves from draft through review and approval to disbursal, with employees, gross and net totals at every step.

videos.title: Payslips
videos.description: Employees see their latest payslip and its deductions, and download any month’s payslip or TDS worksheet as a PDF.

videos.title: Salary Structures and Payroll Setup
videos.description: Define salary components, professional tax, pay cycles and income tax once; see every employee’s salary in Salary Management.

modules.title: Recruitment
modules.description: Hiring from start to finish: new openings, interviews and interviewers, offers and rejections, insights, pipelines and the careers page.

videos.title: Job Openings and Candidates
videos.description: Track open roles with budgets and deadlines, open one to see its hiring details and applicants, filter by stage and review a candidate.

videos.title: Creating a Job Opening
videos.description: A guided form for a new role: basics, workplace, requirements, description, pay and hiring team, the application form, then a review before it goes live.

videos.title: Scheduling Interviews
videos.description: Schedule each interview round with an interviewer and a time, then reschedule or hand it to a different interviewer when plans change.

videos.title: Hiring and Rejecting Candidates
videos.description: Review a candidate’s interview feedback, hire them with a salary and joining date, or reject with a reason; everyone is told, and the candidate list stays current.

videos.title: Recruitment Insights
videos.description: How hiring is going at a glance: active openings, applications, hiring rate, deadlines, what needs attention, and how each role and hiring manager is doing.

videos.title: Hiring Pipelines and Careers Page
videos.description: Define your interview rounds once as pipelines, and publish openings on a public careers page where candidates apply.

modules.title: Performance
modules.description: Review cycles with a self-assessment first and the manager’s review after, tracked to completion.

videos.title: Performance Reviews
videos.description: Review cycles with a self-assessment first and the manager’s review after, statuses that show what’s due, and HR setting up cycles.

modules.title: Workplace
modules.description: Keep everyone informed and supported: announcements, company policies, the helpdesk and notifications.

videos.title: Announcements
videos.description: HR posts company news once and everyone sees it, current items first and past ones kept for reference.

videos.title: Company Policies
videos.description: Every company policy in one library: read it on screen, see when it was last updated, and download it as a PDF.

videos.title: Helpdesk
videos.description: Employees raise tickets for IT, HR or payroll questions; the team tracks priority, response targets and replies, with internal notes for HR only.

videos.title: Notifications
videos.description: The bell shows what changed for you: decisions on your requests, new announcements and things waiting on you, in the app and as push notifications.

modules.title: Reports & Analytics
modules.description: Build your own reports from people data, and see the workforce, attendance and hiring at a glance.

videos.title: Report Builder
videos.description: Pick a data source and columns, add filters and sorting, run it, then save the report to run again or download it as CSV.

videos.title: Analytics
videos.description: Ready-made dashboards for the workforce, leave and attendance, and recruitment: headcount growth, joiners, attendance trends, leave patterns and the hiring funnel.

videos.title: Employee Insights
videos.description: Headcount, workforce status, people by department, and active rate, PF and work-from-home coverage by department, for HR and leadership.

modules.title: Security & Admin
modules.description: Role-Based Access Control, a tamper-proof audit log, organisation settings and your subscription.

videos.title: Roles, Permissions and Teams
videos.description: Role-Based Access Control with Own, Team and Everyone scopes; per-person permissions; and teams whose leads approve their own team’s requests.

videos.title: Audit Log
videos.description: Who changed what, and when: every change to settings and records, filterable by time, area and person, with before and after values and sensitive fields redacted.

videos.title: Organisation Settings
videos.description: Company details and statutory IDs, the work week, HR policy defaults like probation and notice, and more, each applied across the organisation.

videos.title: Subscription and Billing
videos.description: Your plan, renewal date and payment method; switch between Starter, Growth and Enterprise, or monthly and annual billing.

modules.title: AI & Support
modules.description: Use your own AI assistant with Praesto, within your permissions, and reach the Praesto team when you need help.

videos.title: AI Assistants
videos.description: Connect the AI assistant you already use to Praesto through its MCP server, and ask about leave, approvals and your calendar, within your own permissions.

videos.title: Praesto Support
videos.description: Raise bugs, billing questions and ideas with the Praesto team, track every ticket’s status, and reply when they need something from you.

film.title: Praesto: The Complete Tour
film.description: Every part of Praesto in one film: setting up, the screens everyone uses, employees, attendance, leave, payroll, recruitment, performance, the workplace, reports, security and AI.
